newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors sells cars at 30 pct discount.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors sells cars at 30 pct discount.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp, the troubled flagship of South Korea's Kia Group, said on Sunday it had begun selling its main car models at a 29.9 percent discount.
The deep price cut, aimed at raising cash, will apply only to one-sum cash payments until the end of this month.

"The special discount sales would help ease our financial strain," said a Kia spokesman. Included in the discounted models are Sephia and Avella compact cars, Credos mid-sized sedans and Sportage utility vehicles.
On Tuesday, local banks decided to rescue the Kia Group, the country's eighth largest business conglomerate. Its carmaking unit had been battered by slumping domestic sales.
